lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That beacon's been pulsing for days. Too old to be recent. Too structured to be debris.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Dominion signature?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Maybe. Before your time or after it, I can't say. But yes. Dominion built. Dominion abandoned. The galaxy's full of things they made and then forgot.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: If you board, you seal our isolation contract.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I acknowledge the contract.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: They built us. Then they forgot us. Whether that was mercy or malice, I have not decided.

lines.speaker: Security Mech 1
lines.text: Unauthorized contact! Deploying countermeasures!

lines.speaker: Security Mech 2
lines.text: Thermal signature locked! Engaging!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Power core is secure. Moving to bridge access.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: You are one of the Program's operatives.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: I thought we might see you one day. We prepared for it in the records.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: The Meridian was dispatched 200 years ago. Equipped with pre-conditioned subjects in cryo-stasis. The Dominion's own documentation called them "templates." Biological source material.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Source material for what?

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: For operatives. For weapons. An operative designated Ronin-1 was dispatched to oversee their activation. To review the protocols. To prepare them for programming.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: Instead, he chose differently. He wiped the activation data. Freed the subjects from their scheduled programming. Then vanished.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: And the subjects?

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: They thawed. They woke. They found themselves free in the dark of a ship with no destination. My ancestors grew up around them. We have lived free of the Program ever since. Diminished. Sealed. But free.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: We were meant to be a thousand. We are 143.

lines.speaker: Vault Security
lines.text: Unauthorized biometric intrusion! Lethal authorization active!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The ship itself is Dominion architecture.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: Yes. Designed by them. Forgotten by them. We are the forgotten design, and so are you.

lines.speaker: Lira
lines.text: Are you the one Ronin-1's logs promised would come back?

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: No, Lira. He is something else.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: How many of these children are biologically descended from the original subjects?

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: All of them. The colony has been carefully managed. Eight generations of bloodlines, all descended from the templates. We are the proof that you can break the conditioning. We are the living archive that Ronin-1's choice preserved.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: The lower stacks! Pressure cascade! Get the children to the secondary habitats!

lines.speaker: Farm Overseer
lines.text: Primary seals failing! Water containment compromised!

lines.speaker: Repair Drone 1
lines.text: Unauthorized presence! Deploying security protocol!

lines.speaker: Repair Drone 2
lines.text: Containment failure imminent! Escalating countermeasures!

lines.speaker: Lira
lines.text: Ronin-1 saved them. Are you saving us?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: No. I'm trying to understand what I am.

lines.speaker: Ronin-1
lines.text: If you are hearing this, the Program sent you. I cannot stop what they will do with you.

lines.speaker: Ronin-1
lines.text: But I can tell you what they began with. The templates are out there. Dozens of colony ships dispatched across the galaxy before the first operative was trained.

lines.speaker: Ronin-1
lines.text: The subjects are still in cryo. They do not know what was planned for them. I left their coordinates in this archive, sealed against the Dominion. Use it however you decide is right.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: What do you believe now?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I believe Ronin-1 answered the question I didn't know to ask. And I believe I have to answer the one he left open.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: No. No. Not happening. Not again.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Hold it. Hold it together. You've beaten this before.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: It's clear. The broadcast can't go out from here.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That data is worth leverage. Real leverage. Information this old about the Program's origin could purchase allies. Could buy us time.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: Or it should be broadcast openly. Made irretrievable. Let the whole galaxy know what the Dominion did in the dark.

lines.speaker: Lira
lines.text: What would Ronin-1 have done?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: He already answered that. He left the archive intact and waited for a successor to choose. The question is what this successor decides.

lines.speaker: Ronin-12
lines.text: Come back with me. It is mercy.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: That is what you have been told mercy looks like.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Tell Khall what you saw. That the one he is hunting is choosing something other than obedience.

lines.speaker: Ronin-12
lines.text: Overseer Khall is en route. He will reach you before your failsafe finishes.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Then we broadcast first.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: The transmission is live. The beacon is holding. They'll pick it up at every relay station within three sectors.

lines.speaker: Dominion Carrier Commander
lines.text: All boarding teams, prepare for breach! Suppress the communication array!

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: The broadcast is noted. You have made yourself a permanent target, Cipher. The failsafe is still running. I will reach you before it finishes.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Reactor corridor clear! Keep transmitting!

lines.speaker: Boarding Team Leader
lines.text: Target is mobile! Maintaining suppressive fire!

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: The hunters are already moving. There is no amnesty for what you have done here.

lines.speaker: Irene Sols
lines.text: Ronin-1 scattered seeds. You just told the galaxy where they are.

lines.speaker: Lira
lines.text: Are you leaving?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Yes. The Meridian was never going to hold me.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Stellar core approaching! You have two minutes to the point of no-return!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: What are you thinking?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The Program is older than either of us knew. Most of it has not been found yet.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Somewhere in the broadcast now spreading across relay stations, dozens of coordinates wait. Colony ships still adrift and silent. Carrying template operatives in cryo-stasis. Pre-conditioned human beings who never knew what was planned for them.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: They are still out there. Scattered. Frozen. Waiting.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: That is where the next step begins.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The broadcast is out. Ronin-1's archive, the template coordinates, the Program's origin, spreading across every relay in three sectors. The Meridian is ash now. The 143 are free.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: And we're a permanent target. Khall's hunters are moving. But the galaxy knows where the frozen ones are now. That changes the whole board.
